charge_description: Disobeying instructions from harbour master and running a brig under sail through a temporary wooden bridge
raw_record: Summary conviction of William Douglass of Whitby pilot for disobeying the instruction he had received from George Willis harbour master of the port of Whitby, by running a brig called the "Mary of Newcastle" under sail through the temporary wooden bridge erected across Whitby harbour. Offence committed on 29 November 1833.
offence_type: Disobeying instructions from harbour master and running a brig under sail through a temporary wooden bridge
